messages:
frank: Hey team — I uploaded a new draft of the product launch post (internal link in doc). Need a quick pass today on: 1) single-line lead, 2) benchmark claim phrasing + footnote, 3) hero/footer CTA pair, 4) inbound routing for demo vs webinar by region. Can we do a rapid round? :eyes:

lina: On it. Two headline options from me: A) 'Production LLM inference with predictable latency and cost' B) 'Ship LLM features faster with predictable inference economics'. Prefer A for clarity.

helen: Legal quick-pass: benchmarks need hardware + measurement window. Please use: 'up to 4x in internal performance benchmarks (see methodology)' rather than absolute statements. Replace any "our tests" language with 'internal performance benchmarks'. Add dates and baseline config in footnote.

samir: Ops/growth: CTA recommendations — hero primary: 'Book a technical demo', hero secondary: 'See benchmark details', footer CTA: 'Request trial access'. Routing plan: demo -> SDR by region, benchmark -> marketing nurture, trial -> product ops. For EMEA route to EMEA SDR 08:00-18:00 CET; outside those hours fall back to NA SDR.

frank: Good notes. Changed bench phrasing to Helen's wording and added methodology link + test window (Mar 20-28, 2026). Also swapped headline to Lina A.

lina: Design note: hero should feature two CTAs; we'll A/B test hero CTA with 65% demo /35% benchmark. Also need alternative microcopy for ad channels — I'll paste variants in the doc.

helen: Legal approves updated footnote provided the methodology doc has measurement configs (hardware, sequence lengths, batching). Also remove any language that could read as SLA or guaranteed savings.

samir: Pasted routing CSV for ops handoff (small):
```
region,segment,target,owner,preferred_window
NA,SMB,Live-demo,sd-110,09:00-11:00 ET
NA,Enterprise,Tech-deep,sd-210,13:00-16:00 ET
EMEA,SMB,Recorded+book,sd-310,09:00-12:00 CET
EMEA,Enterprise,Live-deep,sd-320,13:00-17:00 CET
APAC,Any,Recorded+local-calendar,sd-410,Weekdays SGT
```

ops-bot: Embargo reminder: DO NOT publish before 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC. Mark doc metadata `embargo: true` and remove public links until embargo lifts. :lock:

frank: Thanks — locking copy with changes, adding embargo flag, and sending to design + ops. Plan: final sign-off by 17:00 UTC and then schedule for publish window. If any blockers speak now. :rocket:
